estimand.population: accountability-relevant passive clauses whose author cannot identify the doer or can identify the doer but declines to name them
estimand.baseline: a natural full disclosure using person: by a person I cannot identify / by a person I can identify but will not name; bare passives excluded
estimand.aggregation: equal weight across six operational domains and both registered forms; report each form as a fixed decomposition; value is the least-favourable tokenizer mean

design.balance: complete 6 x 2 crossing; one fresh pair per cell
design.selection: domains, clauses, continuations, baseline wording, factors, and weights fixed before tokenisation; no item copied from the proposal examples or the three prior manifests inspected on this row; continuations are byte-identical within each pair

manifest.method: For each tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) for each fixed pair, take the arithmetic mean, and report the larger tokenizer mean as the least-favourable token_delta.
manifest.analysis_plan: Preserve tokenizer and per-form means regardless of sign. This deterministic measurement addresses token economy against an honest disclosure only; it does not test routing comprehension or tag fidelity.
